# Mahjong Voice Pack — Supplementary Assets

Supplementary audio assets for Mahjong win-pattern announcements. Each clip is an MP3 voice line naming a specific hand pattern.

## Directory Structure

```
supplementary/
├── mandarin_female/     # Mandarin Chinese — female voice
├── mandarin_male/       # Mandarin Chinese — male voice
├── portuguese_female/   # Portuguese — female voice
└── portuguese_male/     # Portuguese — male voice
```

Each folder contains the same 11 audio files, differing only by language and voice gender.

## Audio Files

| File | Chinese (original) | Description |
|------|-------------------|-------------|
| `ban_ban_hu.mp3` | 板板胡 | Ban Ban Hu — all-pairs win with no sequences |
| `four_winds.mp3` | 四喜 | Four Winds — four wind tile sets |
| `joker_one_flower.mp3` | 将一枝花 | Joker One Flower — pair with a flower tile |
| `mid_game_four_winds.mp3` | 中途四喜 | Mid-game Four Winds — four winds melded during play |
| `mid_game_six_pairs.mp3` | 中途六六顺 | Mid-game Six Pairs — six pairs melded during play |
| `missing_one_suit.mp3` | 缺一色 | Missing One Suit — hand uses only two of three suits |
| `ping_hu.mp3` | 平胡 | Ping Hu — basic flat win (all sequences, no bonus tiles) |
| `single_five_one_flower.mp3` | 单五一枝花 | Single Five One Flower — single five tile with a flower |
| `six_pairs.mp3` | 六六顺 | Six Pairs — six pairs in the winning hand |
| `step_by_step_higher.mp3` | 节节高 | Step by Step Higher — three consecutive frames in sequence |
| `three_identical.mp3` | 三同 | Three Identical — three identical melds |

## Usage

Load the appropriate folder based on the desired language and voice:

```javascript
// Example: play a win announcement
const voice = 'mandarin_female';
const pattern = 'ping_hu';
const audio = new Audio(`${voice}/${pattern}.mp3`);
audio.play();
```

## Naming Convention

- **Folders:** `{language}_{gender}` (snake_case)
- **Files:** `{pattern_name}.mp3` (snake_case, English transliteration of Mahjong terms)

## File Count

- 4 voice packs × 11 patterns = **44 MP3 files** total
